description: Candle Plume brings a real trading chart to Power BI. Drop a date, then Open, High, Low and Close (or a single Price measure: the visual builds the candles). Weekends and holidays leave no gaps, and one click changes the timeframe from 1 minute to 1 year. Free features, no watermark Chart styles: candles, hollow candles, OHLC bars, line and area; up, down and neutral colors. Timeframes: 1m to 1Y buttons, automatic grouping (first open, highest high, lowest low, last close, total volume), market session, fiscal quarters. Volume pane or overlay, with its average. Indicators: SMA and EMA moving averages, median and typical price, computed on bars, never on the calendar. Read and navigate: crosshair legend with OHLC and indicator values, wheel zoom, drag, range buttons (1M to All), log, % or indexed scale. Events: markers from a text measure (buy, sell, flag, letters). Power BI: tooltips, cross-filtering, highlighting, right-click menu, keyboard, high contrast, English and French; 30,000 rows and more with fetchMoreData. Premium features ★ 58 more indicators: Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD, Ichimoku, SuperTrend, VWAP, Parabolic SAR, Stochastic, ADX, ATR, OBV, MFI, Keltner and more, several panes, crossover signals, with an in-visual indicator manager. Positions: long and short trades from a measure or drawn with two clicks, stop and target zones, profit, risk / reward, statistics and…
